nodes.label: Transaction Received

nodes.label: Check Transaction

nodes.description: Transaction passed all pre-execution checks

nodes.label: Transaction Invalid

nodes.label: Increment Sender Nonce
nodes.description: Increment the sender's account nonce by 1

nodes.description: Deduct tx.gas * tx.gas_price from sender balance

nodes.description: Execute transaction via message call processing

ambiguities.text: The multiplier factors '2 (ommer presence) or 1 (no ommers)' for difficulty adjustment is mentioned without detailed formula
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the multiplier is applied to the timestamp adjustment calculation. If parent has ommers, use 2; otherwise use 1 as base multiplier before timestamp delta adjustment.

ambiguities.text: Bomb calculation mentioned as '2^(bomb_periods) added when block_number > BOMB_DELAY_BLOCKS + 200,000'
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume bomb_periods = ((block_number - BOMB_DELAY_BLOCKS) // 100000) - 2, and bomb is only added when this results in a positive exponent.

implicit_assumptions.description: The difficulty bomb provides sufficient incentive to transition away from PoW before becoming unusable
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Chain could become too slow for practical use if bomb not defused or transition not completed

implicit_assumptions.description: Empty account cleanup does not inadvertently delete accounts with value or code
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Loss of funds or contract code if cleanup logic has edge cases

implicit_assumptions.description: The 50% refund cap is sufficient to prevent gas-based DoS attacks via SSTORE refunds
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Potential for amplified gas consumption attacks if refund mechanism is exploitable

implicit_assumptions.description: Miners will continue mining despite reduced block reward from 5 ETH to 3 ETH
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Significant hash rate drop could increase vulnerability to 51% attacks
